prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic late-night home-kitchen snack portrait with cool refrigerator light and warm under-cabinet light, preserving the playful cookie moment.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long layered blonde hair, natural skin texture and a playful over-shoulder smile. She wears a white ribbed sleeveless top, grey heathered drawstring lounge shorts, a small ring and thin necklace, and holds a chocolate-chip cookie near her mouth.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 or 2:3 medium profile portrait. The adult woman stands beside an open stainless refrigerator, torso turned toward camera, right hand holding the cookie near her lips. Include a marble or granite island, open cookie box and white plate, refrigerator contents, stainless stove/oven and microwave, light-grey cabinets, warm under-cabinet light and a candle jar.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool blue light spills from the open refrigerator while warm tungsten under-cabinet light shapes the kitchen, creating realistic mixed-color contrast and gentle shadows. Keep the mood casual, cozy, candid and late-night.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 4:5 smartphone portrait, medium framing, shallow background depth, sharp face, cookie and ribbed fabric, realistic reflective appliances, natural color and low-light detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic late-night home-kitchen snack portrait of one original approved adult woman with long layered blonde hair, natural skin texture and a playful over-shoulder smile. She wears a white ribbed sleeveless top, grey heathered drawstring lounge shorts, a small ring and thin necklace, and holds a chocolate-chip cookie near her mouth. Use a vertical 4:5 or 2:3 medium profile portrait beside an open stainless refrigerator; her torso turns toward camera while her right hand holds the cookie near her lips. Use cool refrigerator blue mixed with warm tungsten light, realistic appliance reflections, shallow background depth and candid late-night color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, food lodged in mouth, unsafe appliance, invented logos, unreadable added text
